info.name: Gazebo - Stock Warehouse Remaining
info.description:
Production warehouse remaining stock, unit-wise (storage locations).

**Endpoint:** `GET /stock/warehouse/remaining/`

Aggregates `stock_balance` (qty > 0, active products) for locations with role `storage`. Each product includes lot-level `pack_breakdown` (display-ready labels) and optional `loose_kg`.

**Vars:** `{{base_url}}` (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8000`), `{{location_id}}` (e.g. `8` = Unit 2, `2` = Unit 11)

request.description:
### Warehouse remaining (all units)

`GET /stock/warehouse/remaining/`

Returns remaining stock for **all storage** locations (e.g. Unit 2, Unit 11), products aggregated per location.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Warehouse remaining stock fetched.",
  "data": [
    {
      "location_id": 8,
      "location_name": "Unit 2",
      "products": [
        {
          "product_id": 123,
          "product_name": "GRAM FLOUR",
          "unit_id": 2,
          "unit_name": "grams",
          "remaining_qty": "1520000",
          "lot_count": 2,
          "pack_quantity": "95",
          "pack_unit_name": "Bag",
          "shape_format_label": "8BAG x 2KG = 16KG",
          "display_kg": "1520",
          "pack_breakdown": [
            {
              "label": "60 Bag (8BAG x 2KG = 16KG)",
              "pack_quantity": "60",
              "pack_unit_name": "Bag",
              "shape_format_label": "8BAG x 2KG = 16KG",
              "display_kg": "960",
              "lot_id": 26148,
              "trace_number": "26148"
            }
          ],
          "loose_kg": null
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Flat pack fields stay for backward compatibility (may be wrong for multi-shape). Prefer `pack_breakdown` when non-empty. Unshaped lot qty → `loose_kg`.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |

### Warehouse remaining (one unit)

`GET /stock/warehouse/remaining/?location_id={{location_id}}`

Filter to one storage warehouse. Same product payload as all-units, including ordered `pack_breakdown` (FIFO) and `loose_kg`.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `location_id` | yes (for this request) | Storage location PK |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status, message, data: [ { location_id, location_name, products: [ { product_id, product_name, remaining_qty, display_kg, pack_breakdown, loose_kg, … } ] } ] }`

Each `pack_breakdown` row: `label` (display-ready), `pack_quantity`, `pack_unit_name`, `shape_format_label`, `display_kg`, `lot_id`, `trace_number`.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | `location_id` not an integer |
| 404 | Location not found or not role=storage |

### Warehouse remaining (Unit 11)

`GET /stock/warehouse/remaining/?location_id=2`

Same as one-unit filter with `location_id=2` (Unit 11).

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `location_id` | yes | `2` = Unit 11 |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

Same shape as one-unit remaining (products with `pack_breakdown` / `loose_kg`).

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | `location_id` not an integer |
| 404 | Location not found or not role=storage |

### Balances (lot-level compare)

`GET /stock/balances/?location_id={{location_id}}`

Lot-level balances for the same unit (not product-aggregated). Useful to compare with warehouse remaining totals and pack breakdown lots.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `location_id` | no | Storage location PK |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status, message, data: [ { lot_id, product_id, quantity, pack_quantity, shape_format_label, display_kg, … } ] }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
